150:         with:
151:           repository: ${{ env.ONTOLOGY_SOURCE_REPO }}
152:           ref: ${{ needs.validate-source.outputs.source_sha }}
153:           path: vault-source
154:           token: ${{ secrets.ONTOLOGY_SOURCE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
155:
156:       - name: Cache the Rust build
157:         uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830
158:         with:
159:           path: |
160:             ~/.cargo/registry/index
161:             ~/.cargo/registry/cache
162:             ~/.cargo/git/db
163:             target
164:           key: vault-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
165:           restore-keys: vault-${{ runner.os }}-
166:
167:       - name: Build `vault`
168:         run: cargo build --release --locked -p vault
169:
170:       - name: vault build (knowledge vault)
171:         run: |
172:           ./target/release/vault --repo vault-source build \
173:             --vault knowledge \
174:             --out "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/output/vault"
175:
176:       # ADR-2147. Every inferred subsumption the generation serves gets a
177:       # derivation certificate (oo-cert/1): asserted.tsv, derivations.tsv with
178:       # the rule and premises of every step, asserted.sha256, scope.tsv. The
179:       # command exits 1 if the certified named closure stops matching Whelk's.
180:       - name: vault certify (derivation certificate, Whelk parity)
181:         run: |
182:           mkdir -p output/certificate
183:           ./target/release/vault --repo vault-source --json certify \
184:             --out "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/output/certificate" \
185:             | tee output/certificate/certify.json
186:           python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('output/certificate/certify.json'));print(f\"derivations {d['certificate']['derivations']}, whelk_parity {d['whelk_parity']}\")"
187:
188:       # The checker is independent of the engine on purpose: it is the
189:       # upstream Lean 4 binary (theorem OOCert.certificate_sound), fetched by
190:       # tag and verified by digest, never built from this repository.
191:       - name: Re-check the certificate with oo-cert
192:         env:
193:           OO_CERT_TAG: v2.0.1
194:           OO_CERT_ASSET: oo-cert-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
195:           OO_CERT_SHA256: 68223b4db193783a52bd2810a66ce2ad3a3780f963a5ef84753564c051e3e532
196:           GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
197:         run: |
198:           mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/oo"
199:           gh release download "$OO_CERT_TAG" --repo fabio-rovai/open-ontologies \
200:             --pattern "$OO_CERT_ASSET" --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/oo"
201:           (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/oo" && echo "$OO_CERT_SHA256  $OO_CERT_ASSET" | sha256sum --check --strict)
202:           chmod +x "$RUNNER_TEMP/oo/$OO_CERT_ASSET"
203:           "$RUNNER_TEMP/oo/$OO_CERT_ASSET" \
204:             output/certificate/asserted.tsv output/certificate/derivations.tsv \
205:             | tee output/certificate/oo-cert.json
206:           python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('output/certificate/oo-cert.json'));sys.exit(0 if d.get('ok') else 1)"
207:
208:       # The digest and the two reports are small and travel with the release;
209:       # the full certificate (~300 MB) is an artefact a reviewer can pull.
210:       - name: Upload certificate reports
211:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
212:         with:
213:           name: ontology-certificate-reports
214:           path: |
215:             output/certificate/certify.json
